brand.name: Scramble Books
brand.tagline: Your books, flowing like a feed

feed.emptyBody: Upload an EPUB or TXT book and Scramble Books chops it into complete reading notes, then streams many books together into a waterfall you scroll like a feed. Everything stays in your browser.

emptyFilter.unread: No unread notes left — you've scrolled through them all.
emptyFilter.read: No read notes yet — go scroll through your first one.
emptyFilter.favorites: Nothing saved yet. Tap the heart on a card to save it.

card.reduceHint: Not interested — show less like this

library.title: My Library
library.uploadHint: Book type is auto-detected after upload. If it's wrong, you can change it anytime in the library.
library.dropText: Click to choose or drop books here
library.dropSubtext: EPUB & TXT supported · files are parsed locally in your browser, never uploaded
library.empty: Your library is empty — upload a book to get started.
library.chaptersOnly: {{chapters}} ch. · reader only, not in Feed
library.deleteBookConfirm: Delete this book? Its reading units, progress, highlights and notes will be removed too.
library.sampleCta: No books yet? Load the sample book “Slow Reading Notes” to try it out
library.failedParse: Failed to parse this file. Please check the format (EPUB / TXT).

bookType.fictionNote: Serialized by chapter — the Feed only surfaces the next episode, never spoilers.

study.title: Study
study.subtitle: Discover → Read → Master
study.readingTimeNote: Estimated total reading time (~400 CJK chars / min)
study.quizBody: After you finish a book, quizzes generated from your highlights, notes and reading units will appear here — turning "scrolled past" into "remembered".

reader.notFoundDesc: The book may still be processing or its local data is missing. Go back and reopen it.
reader.finished: The end — you scrolled through it all
reader.bookmarkHint: Tap the bookmark icon next to a paragraph to mark your spot
reader.searchNoResult: No matches for "{{keyword}}" in this book.
reader.noteHint: Jot down your thoughts… (notes are yours, kept separate from the text)

highlights.title: My highlights ({{count}})
highlights.emptyAll: No highlights or notes yet. Select text while reading to highlight or take a note.

readerModal.backToBookHint: Return to the book and read continuously from here

account.title: Account & Cloud Sync
account.localHint: You're in local mode — data stays in this browser. Sign in to back up to the cloud and sync across devices.
account.inviteHint: Registration is invite-only. No code? Local mode works fully without an account.
account.logoutAsk: You'll return to local mode. Keep the downloaded data on this device?
account.syncFailed: Sync failed; will retry on next change
account.offlineHint: Network unavailable. Changes are saved locally and will sync when online.
account.errPasswordShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
account.errGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again
